G5088.root: a strengthened form of a primary τέκω (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses)
G5088.strongs: to produce (from seed, as a mother, a plant, the earth, etc.), literally or figuratively
G5088.kjv: bear, be born, bring forth, be delivered, be in travail
senses: τίκτω prop., of parents, to beget, bring forth, but esp. the latter, and so always in NT: absol., [[r:LUK.1.57|Luk 1:57 2:6]], [[r:JHN.16.21|Jhn 16:21]], [[r:GAL.4.27|Gal 4:27]]" (LXX) (see M, Pr., 127), [[r:REV.12.2|Rev 12:2]], 4; υἱόν, [[r:MAT.1.21|Mat 1:21, 23 1:25]] [[r:LUK.1.31|Luk 1:31 2:7]], [[r:REV.12.5|Rev 12:5, 13]]; pass., [[r:MAT.2.2|Mat 2:2]], [[r:LUK.2.11|Luk 2:11]]. Metaphorical, of the earth, βοτάνην, [[r:HEB.6.7|Heb 6:7]] (Æsch., al.); of lust, ἁμαρτίαν, [[r:JAS.1.15|Jas 1:15.]]† (AS)

ταράσσω to disturb, trouble, stir up: primarily in physical sense (Hom., Eur.): τ. ὕδωρ, [[r:JHN.1.5|Jhn 1:5]], [[r:JHN.1.7|Jhn 1:7.]] Metaphorical, of the mind (Æsch., Plat., al.), to trouble, disquiet, perplex: [[r:ACT.15.24|Act 15:24]], [[r:GAL.1.7|Gal 1:7 5:10]]; ἑαυτόν (troubled himself; Westc., in l), [[r:JHN.11.33|Jhn 11:33]]; of a crowd, to stir up, [[r:ACT.17.8|Act 17:8, 13]]; pass., [[r:MAT.2.3|Mat 2:3 14:26]], [[r:MRK.6.50|Mrk 6:50]], [[r:LUK.1.12|Luk 1:12 24:38]], [[r:JHN.12.27|Jhn 12:27]] ([[r:PSA.6.4|Psa 6:4]]) [[r:PSA.14.1|Psa 14:1]], 7, [[r:1PE.3.14|1Pe 3:14]]" (LXX); τ. πνεύματι, [[r:JHN.13.21|Jhn 13:21]] (cf. δια-, ἐκ-ταράσσω) (AS)
an end: τ. βίου (Hdt., al.): also without βίου, the end of life, death (Hdt., Plat., al.): [[r:MAT.2.15|Mat 2:15.]]† (AS)

(τίκτω), that which is begotten, born (cf. Scottish bairn), a child of either sex: [[r:MRK.13.12|Mrk 13:12]], [[r:LUK.1.7|Luk 1:7]], [[r:ACT.7.5|Act 7:5]]; pl., [[r:MAT.7.11|Mat 7:11]], [[r:MRK.7.27|Mrk 7:27]], [[r:LUK.1.17|Luk 1:17]], [[r:EPH.6.1|Eph 6:1]], al.; τέκνα ἐπαγγελίας, [[r:ROM.9.8|Rom 9:8]]; τ. τῆς σαρκός, ib.; in a wider sense (as Heb. בָּנִים), of posterity, [[r:MAT.2.18|Mat 2:18]], [[r:LUK.3.8|Luk 3:8]], al.; specif., of a male child, [[r:MAT.21.28|Mat 21:28]], [[r:ACT.21.21|Act 21:21]], a,l.; in voc. as a form of kindly address from an elder to a junior or from a teacher to a disciple, [[r:MAT.9.2|Mat 9:2 21:28]], [[r:MRK.2.5|Mrk 2:5]], [[r:LUK.2.48|Luk 2:48]]; τ. μου (= cl. τ. μοι; see Bl., §37, 5), [[r:GAL.4.19|Gal 4:19]] (τεκνία, WH, txt.), [[r:2TI.2.1|2Ti 2:1.]] Metaphorical,
of disciples (apart from direct address, see supr.): Phm 10, [[r:1TI.1.2|1Ti 1:2]], [[r:TIT.1.4|Tit 1:4]], 3Jo 4;

with reference to the Fatherhood of God (see: πατήρ, γεννάω), τέκνα τ. θεοῦ (cf. [[r:ISA.30.1|Isa 30:1]], [[r:WIS.16.21|Wis 16:21]]): [[r:ROM.8.16|Rom 8:16]], [[r:EPH.5.1|Eph 5:1]], [[r:PHP.2.15|Php 2:15]]; and esp. in Johannine bks. (cf. Westc, Epp. Jo., 94, 120), [[r:JHN.1.12|Jhn 1:12]], [[r:1JN.3.1|1Jn 3:1]] al.; (with) of those who imitate others and are therefore regarded as the spiritual offspring of their exemplars: [[r:MAT.3.9|Mat 3:9]], [[r:LUK.3.8|Luk 3:8]], [[r:JHN.8.39|Jhn 8:39]], [[r:ROM.9.7|Rom 9:7]], [[r:1PE.3.6|1Pe 3:6]]; τ. διαβόλου, [[r:1JN.3.10|1Jn 3:10]];

with an adjectival genitive, frequently rendering a Heb. expression, adopted from LXX or formed on the analogy of its language, but sometimes with parallels in Gk. writers (see Deiss., BS, 161ff.): τέκνα φωτός, [[r:EPH.5.8|Eph 5:8]]; τ. ὑπακοῆς, [[r:1PE.1.14|1Pe 1:14]]; κατάρας, [[r:2PE.2.14|2Pe 2:14]]; ὀργῆς, [[r:EPH.2.3|Eph 2:3.]] SYN.: see: παῖς. (AS)

G5053.strongs: to finish life (by implication, of), i.e. expire (demise)
senses: trans., to complete, finish; esp. τ. τ. αἰῶνα, τ. βίον, to complete life, to die (Æsch., Hdt., al.).

Intrans., to come to an end, hence, to die (Hdt., al.): [[r:MAT.2.19|Mat 2:19 9:18 22:25]], [[r:MRK.9.48|Mrk 9:48]], [[r:LUK.7.2|Luk 7:2]], [[r:JHN.11.39|Jhn 11:39]], [[r:ACT.2.29|Act 2:29 7:15]], [[r:HEB.11.22|Heb 11:22]]; Hebraistically, θανάτῳ τελευτάτω (מוּת, [[r:EXO.21.17|Exo 21:17]]), [[r:MAT.15.4|Mat 15:4]], [[r:MRK.7.10|Mrk 7:10]]" (LXX).† (AS)

τεσσεράκοντα (Rec. τεσσαρ-, v, WH, App., 150; M, Pr., 45 f.; Thackeray, Gr., 62 f., 73 f.), οἱ, αἱ, τά, indecl., forty: [[r:MAT.4.2|Mat 4:2]], [[r:MRK.1.13|Mrk 1:13]], [[r:LUK.4.2|Luk 4:2]], [[r:JHN.2.20|Jhn 2:20]], [[r:ACT.1.3|Act 1:3]], al (AS)

G5087.root: a prolonged form of a primary θέω (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses)
G5087.strongs: to place (in the widest application, literally and figuratively; properly, in a passive or horizontal posture, and thus different from, which properly denotes an upright and active position, while is properly reflexive and utterly prostrate)
G5087.kjv: + advise, appoint, bow, commit, conceive, give, X kneel down, lay (aside, down, up), make, ordain, purpose, put, set (forth), settle, sink down
senses: to place, lay, set: [[r:LUK.6.48|Luk 6:48]], [[r:ROM.9.33|Rom 9:33]], al.; of laying the dead to rest, [[r:MRK.15.47|Mrk 15:47]], [[r:LUK.23.55|Luk 23:55]], [[r:JHN.11.34|Jhn 11:34]], [[r:ACT.7.16|Act 7:16]], al.; before ἐπί, with genitive, [[r:LUK.8.16|Luk 8:16]], [[r:JHN.19.19|Jhn 19:19]], al.; id. with accusative, [[r:MRK.4.21|Mrk 4:21]], [[r:2CO.3.13|2Co 3:13]], al.; ὑπό, [[r:MAT.5.15|Mat 5:15]], al.; παρά, [[r:ACT.4.35|Act 4:35, 37]]. Mid., to have put or placed, to place for oneself: of putting in prison, [[r:ACT.4.3|Act 4:3, 5:18, 25]], al.; of giving counsel, βουλήν, Act 27:12; of laying up in one's heart, [[r:LUK.1.66|Luk 1:66 21:14]] ( [[r:1SA.21.12|1Ki 21:12]]);

to put down, lay down: of bending the knees, τ. γόνατα, to kneel, [[r:MRK.15.19|Mrk 15:19]], [[r:ACT.7.60|Act 7:60]], al.; of putting off garments, [[r:JHN.13.4|Jhn 13:4]]; of laying down life, τ. ψυχήν, [[r:JHN.10.11|Jhn 10:11, 15 17, 18 13:37, 38 15:13]], [[r:1JN.3.16|1Jn 3:16]]; of laying by money, παρ ̓ ἑαυτῷ, [[r:1CO.16.2|1Co 16:2]]; of setting on food, [[r:JHN.2.10|Jhn 2:10]]; metaphorically, of setting forth an idea in symbolism, [[r:MRK.4.30|Mrk 4:30.]]

to make, appoint: [[r:MAT.22.44|Mat 22:44]], [[r:MRK.12.36|Mrk 12:36]], [[r:LUK.20.43|Luk 20:43]], [[r:ACT.2.35|Act 2:35]], [[r:ROM.4.17|Rom 4:17]], al. Mid., to make, set or appoint for oneself: [[r:ACT.20.28|Act 20:28]], [[r:1CO.12.28|1Co 12:28]], [[r:1TH.5.9|1Th 5:9]], [[r:1TI.1.12|1Ti 1:12]], al.; before ἵνα, [[r:JHN.15.16|Jhn 15:16]] (cf. ἀνα-, προσ-ανα-, ἀπο-, δια-, ἀντι-δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-επι-, κατα-, συν-κατα-, μετα-, παρα-, περι-, προ-, προσ-, συν-, ὑπο-τίθημι). (AS)

G5035.strongs: shortly, i.e. without delay, soon, or (by surprise) suddenly, or (by implication, of ease) readily
senses: (neut. of ταχύς), adv., quickly, speedily, forthwith: [[r:MAT.5.25|Mat 5:25 28:7-8]], [[r:MRK.9.39|Mrk 9:39]], [[r:LUK.15.22|Luk 15:22]], [[r:JHN.11.29|Jhn 11:29]], [[r:REV.2.16|Rev 2:16 3:11 11:14 22:7, 12 22:2]] o. Compar., τάχειον (T, Rec. τάχιον), = cl. θᾶσσον, θᾶττον (Att..), (see Bl., § 44, 3): [[r:JHN.13.27|Jhn 13:27 20:4]], [[r:1TI.3.14|1Ti 3:14]] (T, Rec.), [[r:HEB.13.19|Heb 13:19, 23]] Superl., τάχιστα: ὡς τ., as quickly as possible (BL, § 11, 3), [[r:ACT.17.15|Act 17:15.]]† (AS)

G5057.strongs: a tax-farmer, i.e. collector of public revenue
senses: A subordinate of the former, who collected taxes or tolls in a particular district, a tax-gatherer (EV, publican): [[r:MAT.5.46|Mat 5:46 10:3]], [[r:LUK.3.12|Luk 3:12 5:27, 29 7:29 18:10-11, 13]]; pl., τ. κ. ἁμαρτωλοί, [[r:MAT.9.10|Mat 9:10-11 11:19]], [[r:MRK.2.15|Mrk 2:15-16]], [[r:LUK.5.30|Luk 5:30 7:34 15:1]]; τ. κ. πόρναι, [[r:MAT.21.31|Mat 21:31-32]]; ὁ ἐθνικὸς κ. ὁ τ., [[r:MAT.18.17|Mat 18:17]] (cf. DB, iv, 172; ext., 394 f.; MM, xxiv).† (AS)

G5046.strongs: complete (in various applications of labor, growth, mental and moral character, etc.); neuter (as noun, with) completeness
senses: (τέλος), having reached its end, finished, mature, complete, perfect;
of persons, primarily of physical development,

full-grown, mature: [[r:HEB.5.14|Heb 5:14]]; ethically: [[r:PHP.3.15|Php 3:15]]; opposite to νήπιος (-άζειν), [[r:1CO.2.6|1Co 2:6 14:20]], [[r:EPH.4.13|Eph 4:13]]; τ. καὶ πεπληροφορημένοι, [[r:COL.4.12|Col 4:12]]; τ. ἐν Χριστῷ, [[r:COL.1.28|Col 1:28]];

complete, perfect (expressing the simple idea of complete goodness, without reference either to maturity or to the philosophical idea of a τέλος; see Hort on [[r:JAS.1.4|Jas 1:4]]): [[r:MAT.5.48|Mat 5:48 19:21]], [[r:JAS.1.4|Jas 1:4 3:2]]; of God, [[r:MAT.5.48|Mat 5:48.]]

Of things, complete, perfect: [[r:ROM.12.2|Rom 12:2]]; ἔργον, [[r:JAS.1.4|Jas 1:4]]; νόμος, [[r:JAS.1.25|Jas 1:25]]; δώρημα, [[r:JAS.1.17|Jas 1:17]]; ἀγάπη, [[r:1JN.4.18|1Jn 4:18]]; τὸ τ., [[r:1CO.13.10|1Co 13:10]]; compar., τελειοτέρα (σκηνή), [[r:HEB.9.11|Heb 9:11.]] (There is probably no reference in St. Paul's usage to the use of this term in the ancient mysteries; cf. ICC on [[r:COL.1.28|Col 1:28]]; but see also Lft., in l, and Notes, 173 f.) † SYN.: see: ὁλόκληρος (and cf. Rendall, He., 158 ff.) (AS)

G5009.root: neuter contraction of a presumed derivative of ταμίας (a dispenser or distributor
G5009.strongs: akin to, to cut); a dispensary or magazine, i.e. a chamber on the ground-floor or interior of an Oriental house (generally used for storage or privacy, a spot for retirement)
senses: (late syncopated form of cl. ταμιεῖον; see M, Pr., 44 f.; Bl., § 6, 5; Thackeray, Gr., 63 ff.; Deiss., BS, 182 f.), -ον, τό,
an inner chamber (Xen., Hell., v, 4, 5 [[r:ISA.26.20|Isa 26:20]], al.): [[r:MAT.6.6|Mat 6:6 24:26]], [[r:LUK.12.3|Luk 12:3]].† (AS)

G5055.strongs: to end, i.e. complete, execute, conclude, discharge (a debt)
G5055.kjv: accomplish, make an end, expire, fill up, finish, go over, pay, perform
senses: to bring to an end, complete, finish: τ. δρόμον, [[r:2TI.4.7|2Ti 4:7]]; τ. λόγους, [[r:MAT.7.28|Mat 7:28 19:1 26:1]]; τ. παραβολάς, [[r:MAT.13.53|Mat 13:53]]; τ. πόλεις, [[r:MAT.10.23|Mat 10:23]]; pass., [[r:REV.15.8|Rev 15:8 20:3, 5 20:7]]; with ptcp., [[r:MAT.11.1|Mat 11:1.]]
to pay (frequently in cl.): [[r:MAT.17.24|Mat 17:24]], [[r:ROM.13.6|Rom 13:6]] (cf. ἀπο-, δια-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-τελέω).† (AS)

G5058.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of [[w:G5057]]
senses: (τελώνης), a custom house (so in MGr.), tollhouse, place of toll: [[r:MAT.9.9|Mat 9:9]], [[r:MRK.2.14|Mrk 2:14]], [[r:LUK.5.27|Luk 5:27]].† (AS)

G5056.root: from a primary τέλλω (to set out for a definite point or goal)
G5056.strongs: properly, the point aimed at as a limit, i.e. (by implication) the conclusion of an act or state (termination (literally, figuratively or indefinitely), result (immediate, ultimate or prophetic), purpose); specially, an impost or levy (as paid)
senses: end: most frequently of the termination or limit of an act or state (in NT also of the end of a period of time, cl. τελευτή), [[r:LUK.1.33|Luk 1:33]], [[r:1CO.10.11|1Co 10:11]], [[r:2CO.3.13|2Co 3:13]], [[r:1PE.4.7|1Pe 4:7]]; by meton., of one who makes an end, [[r:ROM.10.4|Rom 10:4]]; ἕως (ἄχρι, μέκρι) τέλους, [[r:1CO.1.8|1Co 1:8]], [[r:2CO.1.13|2Co 1:13]], [[r:HEB.3.14|Heb 3:14 6:11]], [[r:REV.2.26|Rev 2:26]]; εἰς τ., to or at the end, [[r:MAT.10.22|Mat 10:22]], [[r:MRK.13.13|Mrk 13:13]], [[r:LUK.18.5|Luk 18:5]], [[r:JHN.13.1|Jhn 13:1]] (or here, to the uttermost, see Westc., in l); τ. ἔχειν, [[r:LUK.22.37|Luk 22:37]]; adverbially, τὸ δὲ τέλος, finally, [[r:1PE.3.8|1Pe 3:8]]; of the last in a series, [[r:REV.21.6|Rev 21:6 22:13]]; of the issue, fate or destiny, [[r:MAT.26.58|Mat 26:58]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:ROM.6.21|Rom 6:21]], al.; with genitive of person(s), [[r:2CO.11.13|2Co 11:13]], al.; of the aim or purpose, [[r:1TI.1.5|1Ti 1:5.]]
toll, custom, revenue: [[r:ROM.13.7|Rom 13:7]]; pl., as most usually, [[r:MAT.17.25|Mat 17:25]] (AS)

G5011.strongs: depressed, i.e. (figuratively) humiliated (in circumstances or disposition)
G5011.kjv: base, cast down, humble, of low degree (estate), lowly
senses: lowly, of low degree, brought low: [[r:JAS.1.9|Jas 1:9]], [[r:2CO.7.6|2Co 7:6]] (cf. [[r:SIR.25.23|Sir 25:23]]); οἱ τ., opposite to δυνάσται, [[r:LUK.1.52|Luk 1:52]]; τ. ταπεινοῖς (neut., R, txt.; masc., R, mg.; see ICC, in l), [[r:ROM.12.16|Rom 12:16]];

lowly in spirit, humble, in cl. usually in a slighting sense (see Tr., Syn., § xlii; but see also Abbott, Essays, 81), in NT in an honourable sense: [[r:2CO.10.1|2Co 10:1]]; before τ. καρδίᾳ, [[r:MAT.11.29|Mat 11:29]] (cf. [[r:PSA.34.19|Psa 34:19]]); opposite to ὑπερήφανος, [[r:JAS.4.6|Jas 4:6]], [[r:1PE.5.5|1Pe 5:5]]" (LXX).† (AS)

G5089.root: perhaps akin to the alternate of [[w:G0138]], and thus to [[w:G4951]]

G5045.strongs: an artificer (as producer of fabrics), i.e. (specially), a craftsman in wood
senses: an artificer in wood, stone or metal, but esp. a carpenter (see MM, xxiv): [[r:MAT.13.55|Mat 13:55]], [[r:MRK.6.3|Mrk 6:3]].† (AS)

G5076.strongs: the ruler of a fourth part of a country ("tetrarch")
senses: τετραάρχης (Rec. τετράρχης, see supr.), -ου, ὁ (τετρα- in corp. = τέτορα, Doric for τέσσαρα, + ἄρχω), a tetrarch, i.e.
prop., the governor of a fourth part of a region (Strab.);
any petty ruler (Plut.); in NT, of Herod Antipas: [[r:MAT.14.1|Mat 14:1]], [[r:LUK.3.19|Luk 3:19 9:7]], [[r:ACT.13.1|Act 13:1]].† (AS)

G5091.strongs: to prize, i.e. fix a valuation upon; by implication, to revere
senses: to fix the value, price: with accusative of person(s), of Christ, [[r:MAT.27.9|Mat 27:9]] (LXX).

G5070.root: from the multiplicative adverb of [[w:G5064]] and [[w:G5507]]

G5013.strongs: to depress; figuratively, to humiliate (in condition or heart)
senses: (ταπεινός), to make low: ὄρος (βουνόν), [[r:LUK.3.5|Luk 3:5]] (LXX). Metaphorical, to humble, abase: [[r:MAT.18.4|Mat 18:4 23:12]], [[r:LUK.14.11|Luk 14:11 18:14]], [[r:2CO.11.7|2Co 11:7 12:21]], [[r:PHP.2.8|Php 2:8]]; pass., [[r:MAT.23.12|Mat 23:12]], [[r:LUK.14.11|Luk 14:11 18:14]], [[r:PHP.4.12|Php 4:12]]; id. with mid. sense, [[r:JAS.4.10|Jas 4:10]], [[r:1PE.5.6|1Pe 5:6]].† (AS)

G5007.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of the original form of τλάω (to bear
G5007.strongs: equivalent to); a balance (as supporting weights), i.e. (by implication) a certain weight (and thence a coin or rather sum of money) or "talent"
senses: a talent in weight (in Horn. always of gold);
a sum of money, whether gold or silver, equivalent to a talent in weight (see DB, iii, 418 ff.): [[r:MAT.18.24|Mat 18:24 25:15]] ff.† (AS)

G5083.strongs: perhaps akin to); to guard (from loss or injury, properly, by keeping the eye upon; and thus differing from, which is properly to prevent escaping; and from, which implies a fortress or full military lines of apparatus), i.e. to note (a prophecy; figuratively, to fulfil a command); by implication, to detain (in custody; figuratively, to maintain); by extension, to withhold (for personal ends; figuratively, to keep unmarried); by extension, to withhold (for personal ends; figuratively, to keep unmarried)
G5083.kjv: hold fast, keep(- er), (pre-, re-)serve, watch
senses: to watch, give heed to, observe: τ. σάββατον, [[r:JHN.9.16|Jhn 9:16]]; τ. ἐντολήν (-άς), [[r:MAT.19.17|Mat 19:17]], [[r:JHN.14.15|Jhn 14:15 15:10]], [[r:1TI.6.14|1Ti 6:14]], [[r:1JN.2.3|1Jn 2:3-4]] [[r:JHN.3.22|Jn 3:22]] [[r:JHN.3.24|Jn 3:24]] [[r:JHN.5.3|Jn 5:3]], [[r:REV.12.17|Rev 12:17 14:12]]; τ. λόγον (-ους), [[r:JHN.8.51|Jhn 8:51-52, 55 14:23-24 15:20 17:6]], [[r:1JN.2.5|1Jn 2:5]], [[r:REV.3.8|Rev 3:8, 10 22:7, 9]]; τ. νόμον, [[r:ACT.15.5|Act 15:5]], [[r:JAS.2.10|Jas 2:10]]; τ. παράδοσιν, [[r:MRK.7.9|Mrk 7:9]]; τ. ἔργα, [[r:REV.2.26|Rev 2:26]]; τ. γεγραμμένα, [[r:REV.1.3|Rev 1:3]] (cf. δια-, παρα-, συν-τηρέω) SYN.: φυλάσσω, implying custody and protection: τ. expresses the idea of watchful care and "may mark the result of which φ. is the means" (Thayer see word) (AS)

G5037.root: a primary particle (enclitic) of connection or addition
G5037.strongs: both or also (properly, as correlation of)
G5037.kjv: also, and, both, even, then, whether
senses: τέ, enclitic copulative particle (= Lat. -que as καί = and, ac, atque, not very frequently in NT, more than two-thirds of the occurrences being in Ac.

τέ solitarium, and, denoting a closer affinity than καί between words and sentences which it connects (BL, §77, 8): [[r:MAT.28.12|Mat 28:12]], [[r:JHN.4.42|Jhn 4:42]], [[r:ACT.2.33|Act 2:33, 37 40 10:22 11:21]], al.

Denoting a closer connection than simple καί, τὲ... καί, τὲ καί, τὲ... τέ ([[r:ACT.26.16|Act 26:16]] [[r:ROM.14.8|Rom 14:8]]), as well... as also, both... and: [[r:LUK.12.45|Luk 12:45]], [[r:ACT.1.1|Act 1:1 15:9, 21:30]], al.; τὲ... δέ, and... and, [[r:ACT.19.2|Act 19:2]]; τὲ γάρ... ὁμοίως δὲ καί, [[r:ROM.1.26|Rom 1:26, 27]]. (AS)
a wonder, marvel: in NT always pl., τ. κ. σημεῖα, [[r:MAT.24.24|Mat 24:24]], al. (see: σημεῖον) (AS)

(and Ion. and late -ερεν, and late accusative -εν; see WH, App., 150; M, Pr., 36, 45 f.), οἱ, αἱ, -αρα, τά, genitive, -ων, four: [[r:MAT.24.31|Mat 24:31]], [[r:MRK.2.3|Mrk 2:3]], [[r:LUK.2.37|Luk 2:37]], [[r:JHN.11.17|Jhn 11:17 19:23]], [[r:ACT.10.11|Act 10:11]], [[r:REV.4.4|Rev 4:4]], 6, al (AS)

G5092.strongs: a value, i.e. money paid, or (concretely and collectively) valuables; by analogy, esteem (especially of the highest degree), or the dignity itself
senses: a price paid or received: with genitive of person(s), [[r:MAT.27.9|Mat 27:9]]; with genitive of thing(s), [[r:ACT.5.2|Act 5:2-3]]; pl., [[r:ACT.4.34|Act 4:34 19:19]]; τ. αἵματος, [[r:MAT.27.6|Mat 27:6]]; ἠγοράσθητε τιμῆς, [[r:1CO.6.20|1Co 6:20 7:23]]; ὠνεῖσθαι τιμῆς ἀργυρίου, [[r:ACT.7.16|Act 7:16.]]
(θάπτω), burial: [[r:MAT.27.7|Mat 27:7]] (Hdt., al.; for other meanings, see LS, see word, Deiss., BS, 355 f., MM xxiv).† (AS)

G5021.root: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which latter appears only in certain tenses)
G5021.strongs: to arrange in an orderly manner, i.e. assign or dispose (to a certain position or lot)
senses: τάσσω primarily, in military sense, then generally, to draw up in order, arrange in place, assign, appoint, order: with dative (accusative) and inf.
